points.description: States the answer FALSE (the statement is not correct).

Justification: states precisely that if the lock is available (free) when the thread tries to acquire it, the spinlock does not need to spin / acquires it immediately on the first check, so spinning is not required for every attempt.
points.partial_credit: Award 1 mark if it says a spinlock does not always spin or spins only when the lock is held, but does not clearly state the condition that the lock is available/free so no spinning is needed.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE plus the precise justification that when the lock is available a spinlock acquires it without spinning. A TRUE answer, or a justification that is wrong, generic (e.g. only defining a spinlock) or merely implied, earns no marks for the justification, and per the question no justification means no marks overall. Part marks only if the justification is clearly more than half correct, as set out in partial_credit.
